पिश् {c6c} U. (पिंशति-ते)
1 To shape,
fashion, form.
--2 To be organised.
--3 To light, irradiate.
--4 To be
reduced to one's constituent parts
--5
Ved. To adorn, decorate,
--6 To
make ready, prepare.

पिष् {vI.v} {c7c} P. (पिनष्टि, पिष्ट)
1 To
pound, grind, pulverize, crush;
अथवा भवतः प्रवर्तना न कथं पिष्टमियं पिनष्टि
नः

.
--2 To hurt, injure, destroy, kill
(with gen.); क्रमेण पेष्टुं भुवनद्विषामसि
Śi. 1. 40. --

To grind,
pound.
--2 To hurt, injure.
--3 To
give.
--4 To be strong.
--5 To dwell.
{vII.v} {c1c} P., {c10c} U. (पेषति, पेषयति-ते)
To go, move.

पिस् {vI.v} {c1c} P. (पेसति) To go,
move. {vII.v} {c10c} U. (पेसयति-ते)
1 To
go.
--2 To be strong.
--3 To dwell.
--4 To hurt, injure.
--5 To give or
take.

पिश a.
1 Free from sin.
--2
Multiform.

पिशंग a. [पिश् --अंगच् किच्च]
Reddish-brown, reddish, of a tawny
colour; मध्यसमुद्रं ककुभः पिशंगीः
Śi. 3. 33; 1. 6;

पिशंगकः An epithet of Viṣṇu or
his attendant.

पिशाचः [पिशितमाचामति, आ + चम्
बा˚ ड पृषो˚] A fiend, goblin, devil,
spirit, malevolent being;
नन्वाश्वासितः पिशाचोपि भोजनेन

; 12. 44.
--Comp.
--आलयः
phosphorescence.
--द्रुः a kind of tree.
--बाधा --संचारः demoniacal possession.
--भाषा ‘the language of devils’, a
gibberish or corruption of
Sanskrit, one of the lowest
Prākṛta dialects used in plays.
--सभं {1}
an assemblage of fiends. {2}
pandemonium, the hall of their assembly.

पिशाचकिन् m. An epithet of
Kubera, the god of wealth.

1 A she-demon, a
femaleimp.
--2 (At the end of comp.)
Devilish or diabolical fondness for
a thing; किमनया आयुधपिशाचिकया

‘devilish fondness for
fighting’; (पिशाची is used in the same
sense; तस्य खल्वियं
यावज्जीवमायुधपिशाची न हृदयादपक्रामति B.

]
1
Flesh; कुत्रापि नापि खलु हा पिशितस्य
लेशः

.
--2 A
small piece or part.
--Comp.
--अशनः,
--आशः, --आशिन्, --भुज् m. {1} flesh-eater,
a demon, goblin; (छायाः)
संध्यापयोदकपिशाः पिशिताशनानां चरंति Ś. 3. 27.
{2} a man-eater, cannibal. {3} a wolf.

. (b) Memorable for,
commemorating; क्षेत्रं क्षत्रप्रधनपिशुनं
कौरवं तद्भजेथाः

.
--2 Slanderous,
back-biting, calumniating; पिशुनजनं
खलु बिभ्रति क्षितींद्राः

.
--3
Betraying, treacherous.
--4 Harsh,
cruel, unkind.
--5 Wicked, malicious,
malignant.
--6 Low, vile,
contemptible.
--7 Foolish, stupid.
--नः
1 A
slanderer, back-biter, tale-bearer, base
informer, traitor, calumniator;

.
--2
Cotton.
--3 An epithet of Nārada.
--4 A crow.
--5 N. of a goblin (said
to be dangerous to pregnant women).
--नं
1 Betraying.
--2 Saffron.
--Comp.
--वचनं, --वाक्यं slander, detraction,
calumny.

पिशुनयति Den. P. To indicate,
show; पिशुनयति रथस्ते शीकरक्लिन्ननेमिः
Ś. 7. 7.

.
--2
Rubbed together, squeezed or clasped
(as the hands).
--3 Kneaded.
--ष्टं
1
Anything ground, a ground
substance.
--2 Flour, meal; पिष्टं पिनष्टि
‘he grinds flour’; i. e. does a useless
[]
work or a profitless repetition.
--3
Lead.
--Comp.
--उदकं water mixed
with flour.
--पचन a pan for
parching flour, a boiler &c.
--पशुः an
effigy of a beast made with flour.
--पाकभृत् m. a boiler
--पाचकं a boiler.
--पिंडः a cake or ball of flour.
--पूरः
see घृतपूर--पेषः, --पेषणं ‘grinding
flour’; i. e. doing any useless work,
a vain or profitless repetition. ˚न्यायः
see under न्याय.
--मेहः a variety of
diabetes.
--वर्तिः a kind of small ball
made of the flour of barley, pulse or
rice.
--सौरभः (pounded) sandal
wood.

पिष्टकः --कं
1 A cake made of the
flour of any grain.
--2 A baked cake,
bread.
--3 A disease of the eye,
opacity of the cornea.
--कं Pounded
sesamum-seeds.
